err.none: Akukho okuzobekwa: khetha amaphoyli avaliwe noma amasekeli.
note.skipped: Izinto ezishiywe: {n}. Kubekwa kuphela amaphoyli avaliwe namasekeli (vala iphoyli evulekile kuqala).
ask.turn: Jikisa izingxenye [amadigri angu-90/noma iyiphi i-engeli/akukho ukujikisa]
done.plates: Kubekwe izingxenye {n}. Amapuleti asetshenziswe: {sheets}, {eff} % yendawo yawo.
done.roll: Kubekwe izingxenye {n} eroleni. Ubude: {len}; {eff} % yeroli isetshenzisiwe.
note.checked: Kuhlolwe futhi ngokwesimo esiqondile: akukho ngxenye ehlanganayo nenye noma eseduze kwendawo yokuhlukanisa, zonke zingaphakathi kwemikhawulo.
